notes: Adds international weight to planning Welsh adaptation (SI8) for warming above 1.5 degrees, consistent with the UK package's 2 degree planning minimum already in the register; carbon dioxide removal through afforestation and peatland bears on SI6.
summary: On 2 September 2026 the UN Environment Programme published Limiting Overshoot, which found global temperature rise was set to cross 1.5 degrees, likely within a few years. Its most optimistic scenario peaked at 1.8 degrees and most others above 2 degrees. It recommended an overshoot, peak and decline pathway combining deep emission cuts including methane, governed carbon dioxide removal and adaptation, and warned of limits to adaptation.
title: UNEP Limiting Overshoot report: the world is set to cross 1.5 degrees within years, with a best-case peak of 1.8 degrees
